articles.title: Implementation Framework for Data Protection and Digital Public Infrastructure
articles.summary: MeitY issues comprehensive operational guidelines integrating privacy-by-design into national Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) platforms.
prelims: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act mandates Consent Managers for processing personal data.
Data Protection Board of India acts as an independent adjudicatory body for grievances.
India Stack elements include foundational identity (Aadhaar), interoperable payments (UPI), and data-sharing frameworks (Account Aggregator).
articles.mains: Use in GS-2 Governance and Polity questions related to privacy rights, digital service delivery, and regulatory governance frameworks.

articles.title: International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) Expands Conservation Footprint
articles.summary: India leads international consensus among range countries to standardize transboundary monitoring of big cat species.
prelims: IBCA focuses on seven major big cats: Tiger, Lion, Leopard, Snow Leopard, Puma, Jaguar, and Cheetah.
Headquartered in India, backed by initial grant commitments for capacity building and technology transfer.
Aims to eliminate illegal wildlife trade and promote ecological corridors across participating nations.
articles.mains: Cite in GS-3 Environment and Ecology answers regarding global environmental diplomacy, biodiversity protection, and habitat connectivity.

articles.title: National Deep Tech Startup Policy Framework Operationalized
articles.summary: Government launches specialized funding mechanism and fast-track IP filing process for deep-technology ventures.
prelims: Deep Tech refers to innovations based on advanced scientific discoveries in AI, Quantum Computing, and Synthetic Biology.
Policy establishes a dedicated Deep Tech Fund of Funds managed by SIDBI.
Overseen by the Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser (PSA) to ensure alignment with national strategic priorities.
articles.mains: Valuable for GS-3 Science & Technology topics on R&D expenditure, indigenous technology development, and economic self-reliance.

articles.title: India-GCC Economic Partnership Momentum
articles.summary: India and the Gulf Cooperation Council advance talks on a comprehensive economic agreement focusing on trade and energy security.
prelims: GCC consists of six countries: Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, and Bahrain.
GCC is a primary foreign trade bloc for India and a crucial source of foreign inward remittances.
Negotiations encompass trade in goods, services investment regimes, and green energy trade corridors.
articles.mains: Direct application in GS-2 International Relations for questions on West Asia diplomacy, diaspora protection, and energy security.

articles.title: NDMA Releases Updated Urban Flood Mitigation Strategy
articles.summary: New guidelines prioritize green infrastructure and 'Sponge City' principles for fast-growing metropolitan areas.
prelims: Urban Flooding is categorized as a distinct disaster due to rapid land-use change and impervious surface growth.
Advocates for 'Sponge City' design elements including permeable pavements, rain gardens, and wetland restoration.
Mandates integration of Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) with real-time early warning systems.
articles.mains: Essential for GS-3 Disaster Management and GS-1 Urbanization questions on climate resilience and sustainable infrastructure planning.
